item.description: A firsthand Epic implementation lesson on meaningful sign-off, leadership transitions, order-set dependencies, and deciding what belongs after go-live.

item.title: The First-Day Checklist That Makes an Epic Consultant Useful Faster
item.description: Epic, ServiceNow, email, Office, and Teams access can delay a consultant's start. A practical onboarding checklist drawn from firsthand project experience.

item.title: Before You Accept an Epic Contract, Ask These Questions

item.title: A Great Epic Consultant Fixes the Cause, Not Just the Ticket
item.description: A recurring medication billing issue revealed a rule affecting the wrong hospital. A firsthand lesson in investigation, collaboration, and root-cause thinking.
